intro.content2: Our pursuit of operational excellence is fueled by robust, modern software architecture. Our flagship product, MLTK (Multi Lingual Tool Kit), is a powerful MS Excel Add-in designed to eliminate the headache of international data merging by natively supporting over 370 distinct standards and locales. Built to streamline global corporate communications, it is fully powered by MLTK-Core, our robust JavaScript library available to developers worldwide via npm to build the next generation of multilingual applications.
